# Simplified or regular: which home office deduction is worth more?

> Free home office deduction calculator for the self-employed: compare the IRS simplified method ($5 per sq ft, max $1,500) with the regular Form 8829 method, including the gross income limit, depreciation and carryover. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
